_comment: Site-wide settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
_siteUrl_help: Final address with https and no trailing slash. Canonical tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt and agents.md all use it.
_brand_help: The site's own name. Shown in the header, titles, schema and footer.
_wordmark_help: Header logo text in three parts: before, highlighted (accent colour), after.

fulfillment.name: 1 Exam Prep
fulfillment.note: Orders are processed, shipped and supported by 1 Exam Prep, our fulfillment center.

tagline: NASCLA exam prep for commercial contractors, electricians and business and law, state by state
_logo_help: Organization logo and default social preview. shared/logo.png is generated by build.py.
_siteKey_help: The site's tracker key from the dashboard (Settings > Tracker). Page views and Buy now clicks reach the dashboard once this is set.
_leadForm_help: GoHighLevel form shown in the home hero, at the bottom of the home page and on /contact/. shared/site.js injects it. Set the form's redirect in GHL to /thank-you/. Paste brand/ghl-form.css into the form's Custom CSS.
_imageUrls_help: Photo slots that use a Shopify Files link (Content > Files). Key = slot filename from build.py, value = the file's cdn.shopify.com URL. 1672x941 originals; the build adds width= sizes for srcset. A slot with no entry here falls back to shared/img/<file>, then to a placeholder.
